__doc: The gradient keys a gradient setting's css_property holds (coverage plan d1, 2026-10-20). Each names a paint mechanism, because two gradients on one element must stay apart in the framework DB's slots (db-consistency F6): a text gradient (clipped) and a background gradient both paint background-image, a border gradient a masked ::before ring's background (or border-image on sgs/separator), an SVG gradient the fill or stroke beside its flat colour. `paints`: the CSS properties the computed route reads the key as (scripts/computed-route/lib/db.mjs::GRADIENT_PAINTS). `base`: the base colour setting's property that gives a gradient sibling the manifest does not map this key, tried in file order (a link colour before the plain colour it also lists); behavioural-analyser/extract-signatures.py::_route_gradient_rows. check-colour-attr-css-property.py refuses a gradient css_property that is neither a CSS property nor one of these keys.
